title: Real-time dashboard loads with live metrics
description: This test verifies that the main dashboard opens successfully and shows the live operational metrics and activity views needed for fraud monitoring.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify KPI metrics are displayed
Verify live threat activity is displayed

title: Dashboard updates with refreshed activity
description: This test verifies that the dashboard reflects ongoing live updates in its metrics and transaction activity views.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify live KPI metrics are displayed
Verify the transaction activity list is displayed

title: Search narrows dashboard transactions
description: This test verifies that a user can search the dashboard for a transaction and see only matching results with their risk details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Activate search using the keyboard shortcut
Enter an order identifier into the search field
Verify matching transaction results are displayed
Verify transaction risk signals are displayed

title: Search supports different transaction attributes
description: This test verifies that searching by a customer identifier, decision, or amount narrows the transaction list to relevant matches.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Activate search using the keyboard shortcut
Enter a customer identifier into the search field
Verify filtered transaction results are displayed
Verify the matching decision or amount is reflected in the results

title: Generate and score sample transactions
description: This verifies an admin can generate sample transactions and run them through scoring so results are available for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate sample transactions and score them through all agents
Verify the generated transactions have risk scores and decisions available
Verify agent breakdown details are available for the generated transactions

title: Review pipeline stages for a transaction
description: This test verifies that a user can open the pipeline progress view for a transaction and see stage-by-stage scoring details.

steps.description: Navigate to /progress
Verify pipeline stage progression is displayed
Verify a transaction audit timeline is displayed

title: Orchestrator agent page shows fusion logic details
description: This test verifies that the orchestrator agent detail page opens and presents the scoring and routing information needed for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /agents/orchestrator
Verify fusion logic details are displayed
Verify policy routing details are displayed

title: Inspect per-agent contribution and timing
description: This test verifies that a user can compare agent contribution and timing information within the pipeline progress view.

steps.description: Navigate to /progress
Verify per-agent contribution details are displayed
Verify per-agent timing details are displayed

title: Generate a batch of sample transactions
description: This verifies an admin can create a new batch of sample transactions and see them added to the system.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate a batch of sample transactions using a chosen pattern
Verify the new sample transactions are visible in the system

title: Behavior agent page shows telemetry and scoring metrics
description: This test verifies that the behavior agent detail page opens and presents session telemetry and behavior scoring information.

steps.description: Navigate to /agents/behavior
Verify session telemetry details are displayed
Verify behavior scoring metrics are displayed

title: Review audit events for a transaction
description: This test verifies that a user can inspect the audit event history associated with a transaction in the progress view.

steps.description: Navigate to /progress
Verify a transaction audit timeline is displayed
Verify audit event details are displayed

title: Device agent page shows fingerprinting and trust signals
description: This test verifies that the device agent detail page opens and presents device fingerprinting and trust verdict information.

steps.description: Navigate to /agents/device
Verify device fingerprinting signals are displayed
Verify device trust verdict details are displayed

title: See generated transactions in the live dashboard
description: This verifies newly generated transactions appear in the live dashboard after generation.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate a batch of sample transactions using a chosen pattern
Open the live dashboard
Verify the newly generated transactions are visible in the transaction list

title: Log in to access protected views
description: This test verifies that an authenticated user can sign in and reach the protected application area.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Enter {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Enter {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated session state is displayed
Verify access to the protected area is available

title: Generate and score transactions for full review
description: This verifies sample generation with scoring produces transactions that can be reviewed for operational fraud analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate sample transactions and score them through all agents
Open the live dashboard
Verify scored transactions are visible in the transaction list
Verify the transaction results include decision information

title: Clearing search restores the default transaction list
description: This test verifies that removing a search query returns the dashboard to its full default transaction list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Activate search using the keyboard shortcut
Enter a search query into the search field
Clear the search query
Verify the default transaction list is displayed

title: Generate sample transactions and inspect policy impact
description: This verifies generated transactions are available for downstream review of scoring and policy-driven outcomes.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate a batch of sample transactions using a chosen pattern
Generate and score sample transactions through all agents
Verify the generated transactions are available for review with scoring results

title: Open the current user profile
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can open the current user profile view and see their account details.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Enter {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Enter {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Open the current user profile view
Verify the logged-in user details are displayed

title: Generate transactions with a different pattern
description: This verifies an admin can choose an alternate sample pattern and still create transactions successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate a batch of sample transactions using a different pattern
Verify the generated transactions are visible in the system

title: Generate a second batch after the first
description: This verifies an admin can create more than one batch of sample transactions in a session and see the latest batch added.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Generate a batch of sample transactions using a chosen pattern
Generate another batch of sample transactions using a chosen pattern
Verify both generated batches are visible in the system

title: Register a new account
description: This test verifies that a user can submit the registration form and see confirmation that the account was created.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Enter a valid email address into the email field
Enter a valid password into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify account creation confirmation is visible
